title: Cement deliveries to Morocco increase in August 2026
summary: Cement deliveries to Morocco increase in August 2026
body_markdown:
**Morocco:** Cement deliveries to Morocco reached 1.3Mt in August 2026, a decrease of 3.5% year-on-year from 1.35Mt in August 2025, according to data from members of the Professional Association of Cement Manufacturers (APC). Over the first eight months of the year, the decline was more limited, with a cumulative decrease of 1%. This trend is mainly due to the decline in deliveries to the construction sector, which fell by 37% year-on-year. However, deliveries for infrastructure projects increased by 20% in August 2026.


Over the first eight months of 2026, cumulative deliveries amounted to 9.5Mt, compared to 9.6Mt at the end of August 2025, representing a decline of 1%.
